name: fno_fire_cqr
description: FIRE-family distribution-conditioned residual where the LF predictive distribution comes from snapshot ensemble + conformal calibration (coverage-guaranteed percentiles). Shares the backbone + residual pipeline (models/_common/fire_core,fire_methods) with the other fire_* families so the ablation isolates the UNCERTAINTY SOURCE. HF = mu_LF + delta(x,[mu,sigma,q10,q50,q90]).
paper: Romano et al. 2019 Conformalized Quantile Regression (arXiv:1905.03222)
